title: English Practice Quiz 0944
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: The first step in solving a workplace problem is to ___.
questions.explanation: A clear understanding of the problem is necessary before selecting a solution.

questions.question: Root cause analysis aims to identify ___.
options: the underlying reason a problem occurred
the person with the loudest voice
the last person to enter the room
questions.explanation: Root cause analysis looks beyond symptoms to underlying causes.

questions.question: When comparing possible solutions, consider their cost, risks and ___.
questions.explanation: Effectiveness helps determine whether a solution will address the problem.

questions.question: A temporary measure used while a permanent fix is prepared is called a ___.
questions.explanation: An interim solution addresses the issue temporarily.

questions.question: A process map helps a team understand ___.
options: the steps and sequence of a process
questions.explanation: A process map visualises how work moves through different steps.

questions.question: If a proposed solution does not work, the team should ___.
options: review the outcome and adjust the approach
questions.explanation: Reviewing results supports learning and improvement.

questions.question: A measurable improvement target should include ___.
questions.explanation: A measurable indicator shows whether improvement has occurred.

questions.question: A contingency plan describes what to do ___.
options: if an expected plan cannot proceed
when everything goes exactly as planned only
questions.explanation: Contingency plans prepare for possible disruptions.

questions.question: When reporting a recurring problem, include how often it occurs and ___.
options: the conditions in which it happens
questions.explanation: Frequency and circumstances help identify patterns.

questions.question: A lessons-learned review is held to ___.
options: identify what worked and what should improve next time
questions.explanation: Lessons learned support better future performance.
